paired_http.percentile: Unrounded nearest rank over all1000 durations; every error blocks the run.
paired_http.gate: Each of3 W1 runs has zeroerrors, p95<300ms, p95 below its pairedW0, peakgroupmemory<=5GiB, noOOM/pidsmax/orphan/UNKNOWNcleanup. FailedW0 latency alone is recorded baseline, not candidate selection. Stop on first failedW1; do not execute laterpairs or retry to select.
paired_http.series: No request-specific sleeps, prewarming, pool drains or benchmark-only refill scheduling. Record ready-hit/miss/refill/cancellation metadata alongside complete raw requests/responses. Every refill/helper and privateworker remains within same measured whole-stack group.

cold.gate: Noerrors; startup-to-READY maximum<10s; first-operation p95<1000ms and maximum<3000ms afterserviceREADY. Report exact coldmiss counts and allrawsamples.
cold.clocks: Service READY is the existing successful health/DocumentRuntime readiness after process launch; lazy pool is empty. Record launch-to-serviceREADY separately. First request starts with zero standby and is measured from driver send through full response. Idle cycle first establishes worker READY, waits for actual30s expiry plus positive cleanup, then sends demand with no standby. No benchmark prefill.

sustained.gate: Open-loop distinct edits, zeroerrors/rejections, p95<300ms,p99<600ms; include late/failed requests. Separately sweep to saturation and test bursts2/4/8 withboundedoverload; no unsupported throughput promises.
sustained.clocks: Schedule attempts against a monotonic fixed arrival timeline independent of prior responses. Latency starts at scheduled arrival, not delayed actual send; preserve scheduled/actual send/response times and every attempt, including rejection/timeout/driver lateness. Do not drop late requests or introduce coordinated omission.

soak.gate: One-hour target-profile soak plus10000-request sequence using real refill/expiry/cleanup. Record whole-stackCPU/RSS/memory.events,workerthreads/FDs/tempfiles/cgroupmembership and exactly-once generations. NoOOM,orphan,UNKNOWNcleanup,unboundedqueue or steady retained-sourcegrowth. Preserve failure evidence; bounded evidence only.
